name: Teng Chong Huo Shan Re Hai Lu You Qu
hours: 07:00–18:00 (Apr–Oct) · 08:00–17:00 (Nov–Mar); last entry usually 1h before close
hl: 腾冲火山热海旅游区，位于中华人民共和国云南省腾冲市城区西南约11千米处，为腾冲众多地热区之一，属于腾冲火山地热国家地质公园。2016年经批准为国家5A级旅游景区，2017年3月3日正式挂牌。 热海地热区内水热活动强烈，有沸泉、热水池、喷气孔、蒸气地面等类型。有热泉、沸泉35个，其中沸泉13个。热水温度为42℃至96℃，且常发生水热爆炸。著名景点有大滚锅、眼镜泉、珍珠泉、鼓鸣泉、怀胎井、蛤蟆嘴、狮子头、澡塘河等。其中最有名的是大滚锅，为热海地热区高温中心，直径6.12米，水深1.5米，因形似大锅而得名；底部有3个喷水孔，涌水量0.94升/秒，水面温度96.

hl: Công viên Thuỷ Hoa（Công viên Thuỷ Hoa）is a visitor attraction in Yunnan, Yunnan — set aside 2–3 hours for the main circuit.
Best season: Mar–May, Sep–Nov. Arrive within 30 minutes of opening to stay ahead of tour groups.
Expect around ¥60 for the main ticket; peak holidays may sell out — book ahead when caps apply.
how: Gateway: Yunnan, Yunnan. Reach the city by high-speed rail or flight, then local bus, taxi or DiDi to the gate (often 30–90 minutes). Use the Chinese name「Công viên Thuỷ Hoa」in map/taxi apps — English signs are uneven.
tips: Carry your passport: many ticketed sites in Yunnan require real-name booking for foreign visitors.
Pay with Alipay or WeChat Pay (link an international card before you travel); cash is rarely useful.
Avoid the first three days of Golden Week (early Oct) and the Spring Festival rush if you want quieter paths.
hotel: Base in Yunnan: comfortable 3–4★ hotels typically ¥250–750/night within a taxi ride of the site; book early for weekends and holidays.
